summary: Murano Global Investments Plc disclosed in a Form 6-K that on October 6, 2026, Nasdaq's Listing Qualifications Department granted a second 180-day compliance period, through April 5, 2027, to cure its failure to maintain a $1.00 minimum bid price under Listing Rule 5550(a)(2). The initial period, from an April 7, 2026 deficiency notice, expired October 5, 2026 without compliance. Eligibility rested on meeting market value of publicly held shares and other Capital Market criteria. The issuer has notified Nasdaq it may effect a reverse share split. Shares continue trading as MRNO. Watch for reverse-split timing and any delisting risk.
